verdict.rationale: NVIDIA ships official first-party SDKs for building on this GPU: the CUDA Toolkit development environment, CUDA Tile C++ and cuTile Python for writing tile kernels, the Nsight Compute/Systems profiling tools, and RTX SDKs such as Neural Shaders and Mega Geometry. Independent benchmarking of 60+ CUDA/OptiX workloads on the RTX 5090 confirms developers are building against these SDKs on this card. missing for 10: explicit documentation tying SDK version support to the RTX 5090/Blackwell consumer card, in-depth SDK documentation beyond marketing-level summaries, and hands-on developer reports of building with the SDKs (as opposed to benchmarks).
